notes.title: The next free game from Epic is a physics-based puzzle game in space
notes.content:
It's Thursday, and you know what that means - another round of free PC games from the Epic Games Store. This week, you can grab the 4X game Galactic Civilizations III, and as ever, Epic has revealed next week's freebie, too. Relicta is a physics-based puzzle game that's set on the moon.

You'll be able to grab Relicta from the usual Epic Games Store promotion page on Thursday, January 20 at 8am PST / 11am EST / 4pm GMT. It'll be there for one full week, at which point it'll be replaced by another freebie. As always, you'll 'purchase' the game at a price of zero dollars, and it'll remain in your library just like any game you might pay money for.

The store page describes Relicta as "a first-person physics-based puzzle game where you need to creatively combine magnetism and gravity to unravel the secrets of Chandra Base." Alongside heaps of puzzles, you've got a narrative to experience while you trek through vacant environments on the moon.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Relicta: Aegir Gig & Ice Queen – Live Now!
notes.content:
Dear physicist, long time no see! 

A lot has happened in these months, don't think that we haven't been working! To thank you for all your support and love, today we bring you a very special update. 

We’re excited to announce that Relicta: Aegir Gig & Ice queen is live now on Steam! Enjoy this free update, available to all players that include two new adventures on the Chandra Base. More dangers! More mysteries! And, of course, more puzzles! 

Update Notes: 

[h2]Aegir Gig [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/83fef6a8fc76f9272c6b8b5d5ca279cf45182355.png[/img]
 
Play as Nic, a bioengineer tasked with testing the gravitomagnetic interfaces in the environments he helped design for AEGIR Labs years before the events of the main game, with even more challenging puzzles to solve as you experience the Chandra Base in a whole new way. Including: 

12 additional puzzles. 

A completely new story! 

[h2]Ice Queen [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/f588651f5567e3f38b57245c2b65b4499a05a017.png[/img]
 

Follows the events in the main story, as you play as one of the survivors of Chandra Base after the end of Relicta. Alone in the depths of the moon, you will discover: 

A new Bioma. 

12 additional puzzles. 

Two new mechanics. 

Know what happened in the derelict lunar base! 

After updating, you will find this new content on your main menu whatever the status of your game was. However, we recommend having finished the original story to keep up to date with the story and get to know the mechanics as much as possible. The new puzzles have no mercy on anyone...  

Also, to celebrate this launch, enjoy a [b]50% discount[/b] on Relicta! We will be doing some giveaways on our social media during the rest of the month. Stay tuned! 

[b]Follow us![/b]
[url=https://twitter.com/MightyPolygon]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/mightypolygon/?hl=en]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/MightyPolygon/]Facebook[/url]

[i]Keep experimenting[/i],
Mighty Polygon

notes.title: Speedrun Challenge!
notes.content:
[h1]Time to run![/h1]

Hello everyone! Welcome once again!

Today we bring you a [b]new challenge for the Relicta demo[/b]. This time you need to beat the demo in the shortest time possible. You will have the demo available from today to monday[b] (July 17 to 20)[/b]. 

Those of you who haven't tried it yet will have the opportunity to play Relicta for the first time and see how much time you need to overcome it. For those who have already played it... Let the race begin! You can try as many times as you want until you find a score with which you are satisfied.

Take a screenshot of your time and send it to us on any of our social media. You can participate as many times as you want! But only your best score will be count, of course :) 

[h3]Demo time![/h3]
Starts: July 17 15:00 CEST
Finish: July 20 12:00 CEST

[h2]The rules are simple![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/8c022fc873236854c1cf8e91160c7430c246ac50.png[/img]

[h2]What's new on the demo?[/h2]
[h3]Demo 1.3 is here! [/h3]
[list]
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[*] New graphic settings including FPS limit, Render scale, and the option the see the current FPS in-game. 
[*] Added Tobii Eye Tracking support.
[*] Change the [b]Save Game[/b] file in order to support the continuation in the game upon release from the point you were in the demo.
[*] Now if you beat the demo and press continue upon loading you will see the last time you did.
[*] Added some missing translations for the skip scenes system.
[/list]

notes.title: F.A.Q
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/a9278ab091ef9fa974e47f2b2db5d5744b937354.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! One million thanks to all people who played the game these days during The Steam Game Festival. All the feedback and opinions were priceless and we're really happy to know that you enjoyed the experience. We also find out some sneaky bugs and mistakes thanks to you! 

Besides, we had some interesting questions for us on our [url=https://discord.gg/VSTdgue]Discord Server [/url] and we decided that it's a good idea to share some of the answers with you, in case you want to know more about the small details of Relicta and its development. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/2ebd7d803ac877076c5f5b2901645c681625bbc2.png[/img]

[b]What is Relicta?  [/b]
Relicta is a first-person physics-based puzzle game where you need to creatively combine magnetism and gravity in order to unravel the secrets of Chandra Base. Alone in the treacherous depths of the Moon, your scientific mind is the only thing that can keep your daughter alive… 
[b]
 Who is Mighty Polygon? [/b]
Mighty Polygon is an independent game studio established in 2016 based in Valencia, Spain. Our focus is to create original games with strong narratives, that are easy on the eyes and have great mechanics. We make the kind of games we like to play. 
The studio was founded by a bunch of friends that used to work together making games for others. After the company, most of them were working for closed they gathered and decided that it was time to make something of their own. 

[b] And who is who? [/b]
Santi Alex: Business/Programmer/Design  
Luis Solé: Programmer / Design  
Jorge Oliva: Artist  
Javier Sanz: Artist  
Jordi Carazo:  Game Design 
Marta Gil:  CM/PR  

[b] I want to buy the game now, when will you release it?[/b]
Relicta will be released on August 4th, 2020 on all platforms! SO, WE’RE ALMOST THERE! 

[b] Is Relicta going to be released in X platform?[/b]
Relicta will be available on PC, Stadia, PS4, and Xbox One! 

[b]  Is Relicta translated into my language?[/b]
Relicta will be available on the following languages:
Spanish 
English 
French 
Italian 
German 
Japanese 
Korean 
Polish 
Brazilian Portuguese 
Russian 
Simplified Chinese 
Traditional Chinese

[b] Is Relicta going to be on VR? [/b]
Unfortunately, at this time we cannot guarantee that there will be a VR version. We don't know what will happen in the future! Hope you like Relicta on its regular version anyway! 

[b] How long is Relicta in development now? [/b]
We have been working on Relicta for approximately 3 years now a team of an average of 5 people plus some freelance help for Sound Design, Music, and Narrative Design. 

[b] How long will be the full version of Relicta? [/b]
The length of the game should be between 10 to 12 hours or maybe a little bit more. It is hard to measure it since everyone tackles the puzzles in a different way. 

[b] Are there more different mechanics or are the ones we learned in the demo the main ones we will use throughout the game? [/b]
The main mechanic of the game is the combination of magnetism and gravity as you saw in the demo and it will evolve quite a bit through the game while the puzzles start to grow in size and complexity. Besides that we have complementary mechanics like the doors/force fields in the demo, there will be new types and if you saw some of the trailers you might have seen flying drones through the levels. We don't want to share too many details to avoid spoilers but you will also find a new kind of pressure plate for example. There will be plenty of ways to combine everything to solve the puzzles.  Just take into consideration that the demo is part of the beginning of the game and as you advance we will introduce more things and the puzzles will be more challenging 

[b] Will Relicta have other than English voices? [/b]
Unfortunately, no, at this time we can only confirm the English voices. We would love to add more but we are not able to do it right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33599515/2ebd7d803ac877076c5f5b2901645c681625bbc2.png[/img]

[b]Keep experimenting![/b]
